source: convention: high-to-low chop, standing side-on to a band anchored high, feet wide and planted, both hands on the band above the near (left) shoulder; arms stay long and pull down across the body to outside the far (right) hip as the trunk turns on the pelvis (about 45 degrees each way) and the knees bend (the hips' own turn and the back foot's pivot are not posed); angles UNSOURCED
